name: Froxel TAA Reprojection
aliases: Temporal Accumulation with Exponential Moving Average
definition: Temporal anti-aliasing technique adapted for froxel data, which describes in-scattering at a point in space rather than on a surface.
summary: Froxel TAA Reprojection is a temporal anti-aliasing technique for volumetric rendering that blends current in-scattered radiance with reprojected history using an Exponential Moving Average, operating on world-space data rather than pixel-based geometry buffers.
